notes: Claude and Codex threads route through Aliax's shim or our own gateway: endpointFor(service) picks the shim when it answers /__shim, else the gateway, else leaves the CLI default; the claude driver sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, the codex driver sets chatgpt_base_url on thread/start, listens for account/rateLimits/updated and asks account/rateLimits/read once the thread is up, feeding the pinned Codex account's 5h and week windows into the shared usage cache and the footer
